name: Valley of Spirits
summary: Darkspear trolls make their home in the Valley of Spirits, west of Orgrimmar's main thoroughfares. Thatched lodges, tiki poles, and pools mark their place among the city's red stone and iron.

sections.title: A Home for the Darkspear
sections.body: The Valley of Spirits branches west from the Valley of Strength, a quiet enclave for the Darkspear trolls. The tribe settled in Durotar alongside Thrall's orcs, and made this pocket among the crags their gathering place in the city. Trollish craftspeople, spiritualists, and practitioners gather around wooden bridges and winding waters, practicing their arts away from the dry heat of Orgrimmar's main thoroughfares.

sections.title: Keepers of the Craft
sections.body: The valley's lodges and pools draw those who practice magic and wild crafts. Witch doctors, herbalists, and spellcasters gather at the Spirit Lodge and Darkbriar Lodge. At the back, the Talon Gate opens toward the Barrens' open plains, giving wanderers, hunters, and travelers a quick passage beyond the canyon walls.

faq.q: Who lives in the Valley of Spirits?
faq.answer: The Darkspear trolls live in the Valley of Spirits, after settling in Durotar alongside the orcs. Their craftspeople, spiritual leaders, herbalists, and hunters make their homes among troll-style huts and carved tiki totems.

faq.q: Where does the Talon Gate lead?
faq.answer: The Talon Gate at the rear of the Valley of Spirits leads west from Orgrimmar into the Southfury River basin and the plains of the Barrens.

faq.q: What services and trainers are found here?
aliases: what is in valley of spirits
faq.answer: Trainers and merchants for herbalism, cooking, wilderness skills, and magical disciplines can be found across the Valley of Spirits, including at the Spirit Lodge and Darkbriar Lodge.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you find a piece of home and cultural identity in this peaceful enclave among the red canyons of Orgrimmar.
As an herbalist, you can seek the wisdom of local herbalist masters at the valley's lodges, beside its quiet waterways.
